title: Controller simulation before halting
statement: Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration of $D$ on input $x$, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that the run of $D$ from $c$ is not halted at every time $s<t$. Then the conditional machine's run for $t$ steps from the corresponding embedded controller configuration equals the embedded configuration reached by running $D$ from $c$ for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $D,M_1,M_2$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $D$ on input $x$
For every $s<t$, the run of $D$ from $c$ is not halted at time $s$
replaced:
Let $D$, $M_1$, $M_2$ be machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $c$ be a
configuration of $D$ on an input $x$, and let $t$ be a number of steps such
that the run of $D$ from $c$ has not halted at any time $s < t$.  Then the
$t$-step run of the conditional-dispatch machine from the embedded controller
configuration of $c$ equals the embedded controller configuration of the
$t$-step run of $D$ from $c$.
